claims: Chuck Norris is an American martial artist, actor, and action film star.
Chuck Norris had roles in Walker, Texas Ranger.
Chuck Norris had roles in Missing in Action.
Chuck Norris had an undefeated professional karate career.
Chuck Norris earned black belts in Tang Soo Do.
Chuck Norris earned black belts in Tae Kwon Do.
Chuck Norris earned black belts in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu.
Chuck Norris founded Chun Kuk Do.
Chuck Norris fought Bruce Lee in Way of the Dragon (1972).
Chuck Norris starred in numerous 1980s action films.
Chuck Norris played Cordell Walker on TV from 1993 to 2001.
Chuck Norris served in the US Air Force.
Chuck Norris was a conservative activist.
According to BBC and Variety, Chuck Norris passed away in 2026 at age 86.
